subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR wait for live owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source and CI proof only for this session/message-delivery change?
rationale: The code path looks narrowly correct from source inspection, but the changed behavior is user-visible Telegram topic/session delivery and the contributor has not posted after-fix real behavior proof.

options.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept Source-Only Risk
options.body: Merge on source, tests, and CI alone while explicitly owning the risk that real transport/session delivery still drops or misroutes completion messages.

options.title: Pause For Broader Delivery Contract
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent delivery paths first.

recommendation.title: Require Live Delivery Proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent high-confidence history in the task and subagent completion delivery paths touched by this PR.
